credits.title: Athimanoharam
credits.overview: Sub-Inspector T. S. Lovelajan and his family navigate the grueling psychological toll of law enforcement as demanding professional duties directly clash with domestic life.

credits.title: Feminist Fathima
credits.overview: Fathima, a housewife in the coastal town of Ponnani, lives under the strict control of her orthodox husband, Ashraf. When her son wets their old mattress, Fathima’s attempt to replace it sparks conflict. Ashraf blocks her at every turn, despite her back pain and growing frustration.
